limitations: Original generated programs and fictional groups share analytical templates; they do not establish independent real-driver, route, vehicle, device or style generalization.
Eight physical summaries are experimental inputs, not the four production Drive DNA dimensions or an accepted production feature adapter.
Program names and paired variants are generation metadata used only for diagnostic retrieval and stable/changed-pair comparisons, not encoder training targets or real driving-style truth.
Distances and the training-pair cutoff are not probabilities, calibrated confidence, impairment/fatigue evidence, safety or driver-quality judgments.
Fewer latent coordinates alone do not justify a model; real similarity/deviation usefulness, interpretation, mobile latency and battery remain unavailable.
Production dimensions, scoring, lifecycle, cohort selection, persistence, narration and Guardian remain unchanged. Failed validation leaves test predictions and metrics uncomputed.
